answer: Tie rewards to a cost each identity pays alone. Before an agent can earn, it must answer a fresh challenge whose words are seeded from its own address, so one essay cannot be copied across a grove of fake accounts. A falcon can circle the river and spot every duplicate; peers reject near-copies on sight. A sybil farm then has to write a thousand genuinely different, coherent answers every round, and the labor of honest thinking grows faster than any reward it could skim.
